title: Plan with the todo list, then aggregate data
prompt: Use your todo list to plan and track this: the CSV files in sales/ hold this quarter's orders (one file per month). Compute the total revenue per region over all three files and write summary.md with one line per region in the form `Region: 1234.50`, sorted from highest to lowest total, nothing else in the file.
notes: The prompt asks for the todo list, so its use is checked; the totals are the outcome.
